en: Colorized vintage view of a small harbor or riverside quay with stone steps descending to the water, several rowboats and a small white steam or motor boat moored in the calm water. On the embankment stands a distinctive wooden and brick building with a turret, mansard-style metal roof, veranda and ornate windows, likely a riverside restaurant or pavilion. A few men in dark suits stand talking near the steps, and a horse-drawn cart and small white kiosks are visible on the cobblestone street. Industrial chimneys and wooden houses appear in the background, suggesting a northern European town in the early 20th century. There is no visible printed caption or other text on the image side.
